  • Generous capacity with 1 table and 6 chairs: The spacious long table with 6 chairs can accommodate families and friends for smaller gatherings and creates an inviting outdoor gathering place.

Descriptions

Description:

This modern six-piece garden furniture set combines classic design elements with contemporary workmanship. The dining table features a cross-shaped iron frame and black plastic wood tabletop, giving it a simple, yet elegant and modern look. The iron frame guarantees stability and durability, making the table ideal for outdoor use. The chairs impress with their comfort and aesthetics: the breathable wicker pattern ensures optimal ventilation, while the upholstered seat cushions and backrests offer additional comfort - perfect for extended meals or relaxing hours. Ideal for terraces, balconies and other outdoor spaces, this set offers your family many opportunities to share precious moments together.
